lead.headline: McLaurin still has not practised; Jefferson says he intends to play
lead.deck: Nothing of yours plays tonight and no team has practised since Wednesday. You put Gordon in the flex, which is right until McLaurin takes a rep. The tight-end slot still has no cover.
lead.body: Start with the bad news about your own players. Terry McLaurin has not practised since he hurt his hamstring on 2 Oct, and the one line written about him overnight is that it is 'unclear' whether he returns. Jordan Addison, Alvin Kamara and Kyle Monangai all sat out on Wednesday as well. Isaiah Likely was limited with a knee and groin listing that two days of searching have not explained, and no tight end sits behind him on your bench. None of that moved overnight, because no team practises again until this afternoon. What did move is small and good. Justin Jefferson, limited on Wednesday in his first practice since the ankle, told ESPN he intends to play on Sunday. You moved Ollie Gordon into the flex last night in place of Kamara, the healthy back for the one with a sore back, and that follows the order Wednesday's edition gave. As set you project 122.1 against 117.5 and ESPN gives you 52% against Los Gigantes de Teca, whose Ja'Marr Chase is still in the concussion protocol and whose Bucky Irving plays tonight in Dallas. The projection lineup would put McLaurin in the flex over Gordon, 13.2 to 10.9. That is a real gap, and it waits for a practice: if he takes one today or tomorrow, make the swap; if he does not, leave Gordon. Juwan Johnson cleared waivers overnight and is free. He is the tight end to add if Likely is downgraded, because he kicks off at the same hour and the others lock earlier. If Likely misses practice today, add him tonight. Otherwise nothing needs doing.
